name: Yukita Fuuta
source:
A man with a bad personality, who lacks expression and is deadly popular for some reason. From women he receives unconditional love; from men, in turn, antipathy, so he has no friends. Even the fact that he is constantly starting relationships is merely a pretext for making a substitute for a friend.

[Translated from the [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/yubikiri.html]official site[/url]]
